from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        n_samples = max(1024, int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample)))
        n_samples = min(n_samples, 8192)
        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []
        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)
            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)
            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = vecs @ (fnp.diag(1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12))) @ vecs.T)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)

        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),

import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        diag_vars = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_vars, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

            n_samples = 8192

            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 6 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0925 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

                xc = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * xm
            elif i == 1:
                xc = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                xv = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(xc * xc, axis=0), 1e-12)
                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * xm

                xm = xc * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / xv) + diag[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * xm

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        rz = fnp.maximum(z, 0.0)
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(rz, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        zc = z - z_mu
        z_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(zc * zc, axis=0), 1e-12)
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(z_var)
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

            dtype=fnp.float32,

import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(

            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,

            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)

        eps = 1.0e-12
        pi = 3.141592653589793
        relu_corr_slope0 = pi / (2.0 * (pi - 1.0))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width, dtype=fnp.float32)
        second = fnp.eye(width, dtype=fnp.float32)
        rows = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            pre_mu = w.T @ mu
            pre_second = w.T @ second @ w
            pre_cov = pre_second - pre_mu[:, None] * pre_mu[None, :]

            pre_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.diag(pre_cov), eps)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(pre_var)
            alpha = pre_mu / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            out_mu = pre_mu * cdf + sigma * phi
            out_e2 = (pre_mu * pre_mu + pre_var) * cdf + pre_mu * sigma * phi
            out_var = fnp.maximum(out_e2 - out_mu * out_mu, eps)

            denom = sigma[:, None] * sigma[None, :]
            rho = pre_cov / fnp.maximum(denom, eps)
            rho = fnp.minimum(1.0, fnp.maximum(-1.0, rho))

            root = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(1.0 - rho * rho, 0.0))
            zero_relu_corr = (root + (pi - fnp.arccos(rho)) * rho - 1.0) / (pi - 1.0)

            out_std_outer = fnp.sqrt(out_var[:, None] * out_var[None, :])
            local_slope = (
                cdf[:, None]
                * cdf[None, :]
                * denom
                / fnp.maximum(out_std_outer, eps)
            )

            blend = (local_slope - 1.0) / (relu_corr_slope0 - 1.0)
            blend = fnp.minimum(1.0, fnp.maximum(0.0, blend))
            out_corr = rho + blend * (zero_relu_corr - rho)

            out_cov = out_corr * out_std_outer
            second = out_cov + out_mu[:, None] * out_mu[None, :]
            mu = out_mu

            rows.append(fnp.asarray(mu, dtype=fnp.float32))

        return fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        rows = []
        vars_ = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            m = w.T @ mu
            v = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            s = fnp.sqrt(v)
            a = m / s
            p = flops.stats.norm.pdf(a)
            c = flops.stats.norm.cdf(a)

            mu = m * c + s * p
            ez2 = (m * m + v) * c + m * s * p
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            rows.append(mu)
            vars_.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        diag_vars = fnp.stack(vars_, axis=0)

        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

            diag_vars.append(var)

        if depth <= 1:

        if budget is None:

            diag_vars.append(var)

                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

            diag_vars.append(var)

        if depth <= 1:

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        if depth <= 1:

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator

    def setup(self, context):
        self._setup_seed = int(context.seed)

    def teardown(self):
        pass

    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu

import flopscope.numpy as fnp

        depth = int(mlp.depth)

        var = fnp.ones(width)

        diag_vars = []

            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp

        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]

                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))

            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import flopscope as flops
import flopscope.numpy as fnp
from whestbench import BaseEstimator


class Estimator(BaseEstimator):
    def predict(self, mlp, budget):
        width = int(mlp.width)
        depth = int(mlp.depth)
        rng = fnp.random.default_rng(int(mlp.seed))

        mu = fnp.zeros(width)
        var = fnp.ones(width)
        diag_rows = []
        diag_vars = []

        for w in mlp.weights:
            mu_pre = w.T @ mu
            var_pre = fnp.maximum((w * w).T @ var, 1e-12)
            sigma = fnp.sqrt(var_pre)
            alpha = mu_pre / sigma
            phi = flops.stats.norm.pdf(alpha)
            cdf = flops.stats.norm.cdf(alpha)

            mu = mu_pre * cdf + sigma * phi
            ez2 = (mu_pre * mu_pre + var_pre) * cdf + mu_pre * sigma * phi
            var = fnp.maximum(ez2 - mu * mu, 0.0)

            diag_rows.append(mu)
            diag_vars.append(var)

        diag = fnp.asarray(fnp.stack(diag_rows, axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)
        if depth <= 1:
            return diag

        if budget is None:
            n_samples = 8192
        else:
            per_sample = max(1, depth * (2 * width * width + 5 * width))
            n_samples = int((0.0909908329 * float(budget)) / float(per_sample))
            n_samples = max(1024, min(n_samples, 8192))

        n_samples = max(2, 2 * (n_samples // 2))
        half = n_samples // 2

        base = fnp.asarray(rng.standard_normal((half, width), dtype=fnp.float32))
        x = fnp.concatenate((base, -base), axis=0)
        x = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)

        cov = (x.T @ x) / float(n_samples)
        vals, vecs = fnp.linalg.eigh(cov)
        inv_sqrt = (vecs * (1.0 / fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(vals, 1e-12)))[None, :]) @ vecs.T
        x = x @ inv_sqrt

        for i, w in enumerate(mlp.weights[:-1]):
            x = fnp.maximum(x @ w, 0.0)

            if i == 0:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = -0.5 * x + 1.5 * x_match
            elif i == 1:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 0.83 * x + 0.17 * x_match
            elif i == 3:
                x_center = x - fnp.mean(x, axis=0)
                x_var = fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(x_center * x_center, axis=0), 1e-12)
                x_match = x_center * fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(diag_vars[i], 1e-12) / x_var) + diag_rows[i]
                x = 1.035 * x - 0.035 * x_match

        z = x @ mlp.weights[-1]
        final_mc = fnp.asarray(fnp.mean(fnp.maximum(z, 0.0), axis=0), dtype=fnp.float32)

        z_mu = fnp.mean(z, axis=0)
        z_center = z - z_mu
        z_sigma = fnp.sqrt(fnp.maximum(fnp.mean(z_center * z_center, axis=0), 1e-12))
        z_alpha = z_mu / z_sigma
        final_norm = fnp.asarray(
            z_mu * flops.stats.norm.cdf(z_alpha) + z_sigma * flops.stats.norm.pdf(z_alpha),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        final_pred = fnp.asarray(
            0.955 * final_mc + 0.04 * final_norm + 0.005 * diag[-1],
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )

        return fnp.asarray(
            fnp.concatenate((diag[:-1], final_pred[None, :]), axis=0),
            dtype=fnp.float32,
        )
